race.comment: UNOBSCURED (7) resumes from a spell and is having her first outing under new trainer Ben Brisbourne. Finished fifth at Sale over 1112m at the opening run last time in work but has trialled well enough to suggest a big stable debut is on the cards. MAYFAIR STREET (3) is an ex-Kiwi gelding having his first run for Paul Preusker. No trials but was a debut winner in NZ and it's interesting to note he was tested in Listed grade at start No 2. CARIBBEAN VILLA (2) is on the back-up after winning at Dunkeld and wasn't beaten far by a handy one the prior here, which is his home track. Respect. PACIFIC GLAMOUR (5) turned things around last start and got the job done by 0.8 lengths after being prominent at the corner over 1009m at Yarra Valley. No reason to think she won't be around the mark again. FRANCINE (6) might be a veteran now, but the three runs this time in have been in handy BM62 races , so she'll find this easier. Peak fitness now and draws beautifully.
